answer: Start from CTF flag proof with signed scoreboard entry. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 779 pays 14022 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The yarrow of the design is public, the beacon of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the willow of honest work is what finally pays. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
